author: Okkerka
name: GrokCog
short: Groq questions and contextual web fact checks
description: Answer prefix/slash questions, bot mentions, replies and images using Groq. Qwen reads supplied images; fact-check requests use Groq Compound web search with retrieved citations.
install_msg: Configure a Groq key using [p]grok admin apikey in DM or its slash equivalent. Enable slash commands with [p]slash enablecog GrokCog, then [p]slash sync. See the cog README for model selection and examples.
end_user_data_statement: Stores user IDs with successful answer counts and last request timestamps, server preferences and a bot-owner API key in Red Config. Questions, quoted message text, selected signed Discord image URLs and answers are held in bounded in-memory request/cache/UI state. Text and image URLs are sent to Groq, which fetches the images; web-search requests may also be processed by Groq's search tools. Images are not downloaded to disk and no conversation history is persisted by this cog. Red user-data deletion removes user statistics and transient cog data; it cannot delete Discord messages or provider-held data.
